title: Private deployment: operator accountability evidence & SSO/KMS onboarding checklist
creator: Priya Nair
description: This ticket captures the Product Requirements and the sign-off checklist needed for private (VPC/on-prem) customer onboardings that require SSO/SAML, role-based operator access, audit-ready logging, and customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM). It consolidates clarifications from the PRD, enumerates scope changes requested by legal/security, and defines the minimal operator evidence package that must be delivered to gate 'operator-ready' status. The emphasis is operator accountability and verifiable evidence: runbooks, access snapshots, key escrow/rotation demos, audit-log retention proof, and SAML trust artifacts. Decisions logged here reflect trade-offs between time-to-onboard (fast path) and minimal compliance evidence (slow path) for regulated customers. Fast path allows onboarding with a subset of evidence for low-risk customers; regulated customers require full HSM attestation and signed audit packages. This doc also ties acceptance criteria to delivery artifacts (Confluence runbook links, GitHub PRs, IAM snapshots, automated tests) and notes the special-case scope change: adding ephemeral operator keys for on-call escalation (requested 2026-03-02).
acceptance_criteria: SSO/SAML: Successful SAML 2.0 federation test between customer IdP and private control plane demonstrating JIT provisioning and SAML assertion trace for 3 sample flows
RBAC: Mapping of at least three operator roles (Operator, Escalation, Auditor) with documented permissions and a reversible role-binding script checked into infra repo
KMS/HSM: Evidence of customer KMS integration (key import or wrapped-key flow) and HSM presence verification report or attestation document
Audit logs: Demonstrable end-to-end audit log retention for 90 days in a searchable store, with an example query returning a named operator action within 2 minutes
Operator evidence package: Confluence runbook + signed checklist + IAM snapshot + key rotation demo video (<=10 minutes) available in onboarding folder
Fallbacks: Explicit fallback policy documented for SSO downtime (OOB admin token flow) with timeboxed rollback and auditability
Automated checks: CI job that validates role policy diffs and flags any new high-risk permissions (must pass in release branch)
Security review: Security team sign-off (SRE/Security approvers listed in checklist) required before marking Done
checklist: PRD clarifications captured: difference between customer-managed KMS vs Redwood-managed wrap keys — documented (PRD section 4.2)
Scope change log: ephemeral operator keys for escalation added on 2026-03-02 (change approved by security) — update artifact required
SAML metadata exchange: metadata XML files exchanged and stored in customer vault; sample assertions collected
Operator RBAC matrix reviewed and signed by infra-ops and security
HSM attestation or audit report uploaded (or alternative KMS sign-off if HSM not required)
Automated audit query notebook stored in onboarding/replay-notebooks
Runbook walk-through recorded and attached to the ticket
Customer acceptance: onboarding checklist reviewed and acknowledged by customer security contact
